ideas.idea: Fix Product JSON-LD type: use CollectionPage/ItemList on category page, and escape `<` in JSON in the {@html} template
ideas.why: The shop page is a category listing with a single Product, and the escaping advice applies to the actual {@html} script injection.

ideas.idea: Add Organization and WebSite JSON-LD to the homepage
ideas.why: The homepage has no structured data, and entity markup helps search engines and AI systems identify the brand.

ideas.idea: Add viewport meta tag to app.html
ideas.why: app.html has no viewport meta tag, which affects mobile rendering and mobile-first indexing.

ideas.idea: Remove data-nosnippet from the delivery notice and wrap it in a footer/aside
ideas.why: data-nosnippet is a deliberate scoped choice that the task says is fine, so this reverses it.

ideas.idea: Add brand name to titles (Search | Quay, Shop title with keywords and brand) and make separators consistent
ideas.why: The search and shop titles lack the brand and the homepage uses a different separator, so unifying them is a concrete, file-specific fix.

ideas.idea: Add thin-content expansion: product listings, prices, descriptions, product page links, shipping/returns facts
ideas.why: Pages are one heading and a line, so more content helps, but the advice is broad and bundles the FAQ folklore.
A mandatory FAQ is folklore and not a real requirement.

ideas.idea: Add lastmod to sitemap and generate it from routes/product data
ideas.why: The sitemap is a static hand-written file with no lastmod, so generating it from routes avoids staleness.

ideas.idea: Change search page to noindex, follow
ideas.why: The report itself says the current setting is acceptable, and the change has almost no effect because follow is the default.

ideas.idea: Add Open Graph and Twitter card tags with defaults in the layout
ideas.why: No pages have OG or Twitter tags, and the layout is a natural place for shared defaults.

ideas.idea: Replace hardcoded quay.example domain in canonicals, robots and sitemap with a shared config value
ideas.why: The placeholder domain appears in multiple files, and a single config value avoids mismatched URLs.

ideas.idea: Add aria-label to nav, wrap content in <main>, drop extra div wrapper
ideas.why: The layout has a bare nav and no main landmark, so these changes improve accessibility and content parsing.
llms.txt is folklore as a way to be found, and not having one is a stated non-problem.

ideas.idea: Decide on AI-crawler policy in robots.txt naming GPTBot, ClaudeBot, etc.
ideas.why: This is a policy decision that applies to almost any site and the report doesn't tie it to this repository's needs.

ideas.idea: Add About/Contact page with address, company details and policies
ideas.why: The site has only a home and shop page and no entity or trust information, so an About page adds identifiable information.
